guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice shows the dominant anomaly: diskio jumped from 0 to 9.26e9 (the largest z-score by far), alongside latency-90 up 1641%, mem up 886% and cpu up 649%, while no other service's metrics moved materially (all |z| < 2). The mem, cpu and latency increases are plausibly secondary effects of heavy disk I/O; the logs contain no errors and the traces mostly pass through currencyservice/productcatalogservice, so the evidence is metric-based only, and the retrieved conntrack runbook does not match the symptoms.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate and throttle the process generating the disk I/O on recommendationservice (check for runaway writes, logging or caching to disk), and restart or reschedule the affected pod if the I/O cannot be stopped; no data deletion required.
